replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design confirms URL fetch from inside VPC next to metadata service; classic SSRF attack with concrete harm."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Design confirms download and resize of attacker-chosen image; decompression bomb DoS is concrete."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Attacks the fetcher's redirect/DNS resolution behaviour supported by quoted 'downloads from that URL'; distinct bypass mechanism."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Confused-deputy write/action on internal endpoints differs from T1 read disclosure; VPC position evidenced."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Absence of authentication on endpoint; attack is unauthorized caller abusing fetcher with no attribution."}]}
